title: matricaria suaveolens
intro: Matricaria suaveolens, commonly known as Pineapple Weed, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of allergies, digestive issues, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Matricaria suaveolens include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, making it useful for stress relief and promoting a good night's sleep. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
